140a.title: Air and Missile Defense (AMD) Systems Integrator
140a.description: Air defense warrant officer na nagkakabit ng mga sensor, armas at command system para makabuo ng iisang larawan ng air at missile defense.
140a.training: Bukas sa mga kwalipikadong Soldiers (karaniwan ay sergeant pataas sa kaugnay na trabaho); Warrant Officer Candidate School sa Fort Rucker, AL, tapos ang Warrant Officer Basic Course ng branch (ayon sa GoArmy)

140k.title: Air and Missile Defense (AMD) Tactician
140k.description: Air defense warrant officer na nagbibigay ng payo sa mga taktika sa paggamit ng mga air at missile defense system.
140k.training: Bukas sa mga kwalipikadong Soldiers (karaniwan ay sergeant pataas sa kaugnay na trabaho); Warrant Officer Candidate School sa Fort Rucker, AL, tapos ang Warrant Officer Basic Course ng branch (ayon sa GoArmy)

140l.title: Air and Missile Defense (AMD) Technician
140l.description: Air defense warrant officer na technical expert sa mga Patriot-type na missile defense system at sa maintenance ng mga ito.
140l.training: Bukas sa mga kwalipikadong Soldiers (karaniwan ay sergeant pataas sa kaugnay na trabaho); Warrant Officer Candidate School sa Fort Rucker, AL, tapos ang Warrant Officer Basic Course ng branch (ayon sa GoArmy)

14a.title: Air Defense Artillery (ADA) Officer
14a.description: Namumuno sa mga air at missile defense unit na nagpoprotekta sa mga tropa at mahahalagang lugar laban sa mga eroplano, drone, cruise missile at ballistic missile.
14a.training: Ma-commission bilang officer, tapos ang Basic Officer Leader Course (BOLC) para sa branch (ayon sa GoArmy)

14e.title: Patriot Fire Control Enhanced Operator / Maintainer
14e.description: Nag-o-operate at nagme-maintain ng radar at fire-control na bahagi ng Patriot missile system, para ma-detect at ma-engage ang mga banta mula sa himpapawid.
14e.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 20 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

14g.title: Air Defense Battle Management System Operator
14g.description: Nagpapatakbo ng mga air defense command-and-control system, sinusubaybayan ang air picture at ipinapasa ang mga babala sa banta at mga utos sa pag-engage.
14g.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 16 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

14h.title: Air Defense Enhanced Early Warning System Operator
14h.description: Nag-o-operate ng mga early-warning sensor at system, sinusuri ang mga paparating na banta mula sa himpapawid at missile, at nagpapadala ng alerto sa mga kakampi.
14h.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 11 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

14p.title: Air and Missile Defense (AMD) Crewmember
14p.description: Nag-o-operate at nagme-maintain ng mga short-range air defense weapon na nagpapabagsak sa mga drone, eroplano at cruise missile na banta sa mga tropa sa lupa.
14p.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 7 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

14s.title: Avenger Crewmember
14s.description: Bahagi ng crew ng Avenger short-range air defense system, na naghahanap at nag-e-engage ng mga mababang lumilipad na eroplano at drone gamit ang missile at machine gun.
14s.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 10 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

14t.title: Patriot Launching Station Enhanced Operator / Maintainer
14t.description: Nag-o-operate at nagme-maintain ng mga Patriot launching station, inihahanda ang mga launcher para magpaputok at nagpapatakbo ng mga electronic check sa mga ito.
14t.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 7 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

14u.title: Air Defense Artillery (ADA) Recruit
14u.description: Isang air defense enlistment option: nagte-training ang mga recruit sa mga pundasyon ng air at missile defense bago ilagay sa isang partikular na ADA job.
14u.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 7-20 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (AIT) depende sa MOS (ayon sa GoArmy)

14w.title: Air and Missile Defense (AMD) Systems Repairer
14w.description: Isang mas bagong air at missile defense job (itinatag noong Oct. 2026) na pinagsasama ang skills ng Patriot operator at maintainer para mag-monitor, mag-maintain at mag-repair ng mga missile defense system.
14w.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 16 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

150a.title: Air Traffic and Airspace Management Technician
150a.description: Aviation warrant officer na namamahala sa mga air traffic control service at nagko-coordinate ng paggamit ng airspace sa mga operasyon ng Army.
150a.training: Bukas sa mga kwalipikadong Soldiers (karaniwan ay sergeant pataas sa kaugnay na trabaho); Warrant Officer Candidate School sa Fort Rucker, AL, tapos ang Warrant Officer Basic Course ng branch (ayon sa GoArmy)

150u.title: Unmanned Aircraft Systems Operations Technician
150u.description: Aviation warrant officer na namamahala sa mga drone operation, training at safety, at nagpapayo sa mga commander sa paggamit ng unmanned aircraft.
150u.training: Bukas sa mga kwalipikadong Soldiers (karaniwan ay sergeant pataas sa kaugnay na trabaho); Warrant Officer Candidate School sa Fort Rucker, AL, tapos ang Warrant Officer Basic Course ng branch (ayon sa GoArmy)

151a.title: Aviation Maintenance Technician
151a.description: Aviation warrant officer na namamahala sa mga maintenance program ng helicopter at eroplano at pinapanatiling handang lumipad ang fleet.
151a.training: Bukas sa mga kwalipikadong Soldiers (karaniwan ay sergeant pataas sa kaugnay na trabaho); Warrant Officer Candidate School sa Fort Rucker, AL, tapos ang Warrant Officer Basic Course ng branch (ayon sa GoArmy)

153a.title: Rotary Wing Aviator
153a.description: Nagpapalipad ng mga helicopter ng Army sa mga mission tulad ng attack, reconnaissance, air assault, cargo at medical evacuation, at nagsisilbing technical expert ng aircraft.
153a.training: Warrant Officer Candidate School (WOCS), tapos Warrant Officer Flight Training; kailangang maipasa ang SIFT aviation aptitude test (ayon sa GoArmy)

155a.title: Fixed Wing Aviator
155a.description: Nagpapalipad ng mga fixed-wing (eroplano) na aircraft ng Army para sa mga mission tulad ng intelligence collection, transport at command support.
155a.training: Warrant Officer Candidate School (WOCS), tapos Warrant Officer Flight Training; kailangang maipasa ang SIFT aviation aptitude test (ayon sa GoArmy)

15a.title: Aviation Officer
15a.description: Namumuno sa mga aviation unit at nagpapalipad ng mga helicopter ng Army, nagpaplano ng mga mission tulad ng attack, air assault, transport at medical evacuation.
15a.training: Ma-commission bilang officer, tapos ang Basic Officer Leader Course (BOLC) para sa branch (ayon sa GoArmy)

15b.title: Aircraft Powerplant Repairer
15b.description: Nag-i-inspect, nagre-repair at nag-o-overhaul ng mga turbine engine na nagpapaandar sa mga helicopter ng Army.
15b.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 17 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

15c.title: MQ-1 Unmanned Aircraft System (UAS) Operator
15c.description: Nagpapalipad nang remote ng malalaking MQ-1C Gray Eagle drone ng Army, nangangalap ng surveillance at targeting information para sa mga commander.
15c.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 22 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

15d.title: Aircraft Powertrain Repairer
15d.description: Nagre-repair at nagme-maintain ng mga bahagi ng powertrain ng helicopter tulad ng transmission, gearbox, drive shaft at rotor head.
15d.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 20 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

15f.title: Aircraft Electrician
15f.description: Nagta-troubleshoot at nagre-repair ng mga electrical system at wiring sa mga aircraft ng Army.
15f.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 17 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

15g.title: Aircraft Structural Repairer
15g.description: Nagre-repair ng mga structure at skin ng aircraft, kasama ang mga metal at composite na bahaging nasira dahil sa pagkaluma o labanan.
15g.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 16 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

15h.title: Aircraft Pneudraulics Repairer
15h.description: Nagme-maintain at nagre-repair ng mga hydraulic at pneumatic system ng aircraft tulad ng landing gear, preno at flight controls.
15h.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 12 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

15m.title: MQ-1 Unmanned Aircraft System (UAS) Repairer
15m.description: Nagme-maintain at nagre-repair ng MQ-1C Gray Eagle drone at ng ground equipment nito para handa itong lumipad.
15m.training: 24 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training; 10 linggo ng Basic Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

15n.title: Avionic Mechanic
15n.description: Nag-i-install, nagte-test at nagre-repair ng avionics sa mga aircraft ng Army, kasama ang mga electronics para sa navigation, communication at flight control.
15n.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 24 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

15p.title: Aviation Operations Specialist
15p.description: Humahawak sa paperwork at planning ng flight operations, nag-i-schedule ng mga flight, nagta-track ng records ng aircrew at pinapanatiling tuloy-tuloy ang aviation operations.
15p.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 7 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

15q.title: Air Traffic Control (ATC) Operator
15q.description: Kinokontrol ang air traffic ng Army mula sa mga tower at radar facility, ginagabayan nang ligtas ang mga aircraft sa takeoff, landing at paglipad.
15q.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 17 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

15r.title: AH-64 Attack Helicopter Repairer
15r.description: Nagme-maintain at nagre-repair ng AH-64 Apache attack helicopter, nagsasagawa ng mga inspection at inaayos ang airframe at mga system nito.
15r.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 16 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

15t.title: UH-60 Helicopter Repairer/Aircrew Member
15t.description: Nagme-maintain ng UH-60 Black Hawk helicopter at puwede ring lumipad bilang crew chief nito.
15t.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 15 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

15u.title: CH-47 Helicopter Repairer / Aircrew Member
15u.description: Nagme-maintain ng CH-47 Chinook heavy-lift helicopter at puwede ring magsilbing flight crew member nito.
15u.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 17 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

15x.title: Tactical Unmanned Aircraft System (TUAS) Specialist
15x.description: Naglu-launch, nagpapalipad, nagre-recover at nagre-repair ng mga tactical drone ng Army, nangangalap ng reconnaissance tungkol sa kalaban para sa mga unit sa lupa.
15x.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 22 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

15y.title: AH-64 Armament / Electrical / Avionic Systems Repairer
15y.description: Nagme-maintain at nagre-repair ng mga weapons, electrical at avionics system ng AH-64 Apache attack helicopter.
15y.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 23 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

94d.title: Air Traffic Control Equipment Repairer
94d.description: Nagme-maintain at nagre-repair ng radar, navigation at communications equipment ng air traffic control.
94d.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 27 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

94r.title: Avionic and Survivability Equipment Repairer
94r.description: Nagme-maintain at nagre-repair ng avionics at survivability system ng aircraft na nagpoprotekta sa mga aircraft ng Army.
94r.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 17 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

11a.title: Infantry Officer
11a.description: Namumuno sa isang infantry platoon, nagpaplano at nagdidirekta ng mga mission ng mga sundalong naglalakad, at responsable sa training, safety at kapakanan ng mga Soldiers na hawak niya.
11a.training: Ma-commission bilang officer, tapos ang Basic Officer Leader Course (BOLC) para sa branch (ayon sa GoArmy)

11b.title: Infantryman
11b.description: Lumalaban nang naglalakad bilang pangunahing ground combat Soldier ng Army, gamit ang rifle, machine gun at anti-armor weapon para makuha ang teritoryo at talunin ang kalaban.
11b.training: 22 linggo ng One Station Unit Training, na kasama na ang Basic Combat Training at Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

11c.title: Indirect Fire Infantryman
11c.description: Nag-o-operate ng mga mortar, ang sariling short-range indirect-fire weapon ng infantry, kinakalkula ang firing data at nagpapabagsak ng bala sa mga target na hindi direktang matamaan ng mga riflemen.
11c.training: 22 linggo ng One Station Unit Training, na kasama na ang Basic Combat Training at Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

11x.title: Infantryman (11X Enlistment Option)
11x.description: Isang infantry enlistment option: nagte-training ang mga recruit bilang infantry, tapos ia-assign sila ng Army bilang rifleman (11B) o mortarman (11C).
11x.training: 22 linggo ng Infantry One Station Unit Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

131a.title: Field Artillery Technician
131a.description: Artillery targeting expert na namamahala sa target data, mga sensor at fire-support system para tamaan ng artillery ang tamang target.
131a.training: Bukas sa mga kwalipikadong Soldiers (karaniwan ay sergeant pataas sa kaugnay na trabaho); Warrant Officer Candidate School sa Fort Rucker, AL, tapos ang Warrant Officer Basic Course ng branch (ayon sa GoArmy)

13a.title: Field Artillery Officer
13a.description: Namumuno sa mga field artillery unit na nagpaplano at nagpapaputok ng cannon, rocket at missile bilang suporta sa mga tropa sa lupa.
13a.training: Ma-commission bilang officer, tapos ang Basic Officer Leader Course (BOLC) para sa branch (ayon sa GoArmy)

13b.title: Cannon Crewmember
13b.description: Bahagi ng crew ng mga towed o self-propelled na cannon (howitzer), naglo-load, nagta-target at nagpapaputok para tamaan ang mga target na milya-milya ang layo.
13b.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 6 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

13f.title: Joint Fire Support Specialist
13f.description: Nasa unahan kasama ang mga maneuver unit para makita ang mga target at tumawag ng artillery, mortar, air at naval fire, at kino-coordinate ang lahat ng ito sa radyo.
13f.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 10 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

13j.title: Fire Control Specialist
13j.description: Nagpapatakbo ng mga digital fire-direction system na ginagawang firing order ang target data at ipinapasa ang mga ito sa buong artillery network.
13j.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 7 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

13m.title: Multiple Launch Rocket System (MLRS/HIMARS) Crewmember
13m.description: Bahagi ng crew ng MLRS at HIMARS rocket launcher, naglo-load at nagpapaputok ng mga long-range rocket at missile sa malalayong target.
13m.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 7 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

13r.title: Weapons Locating Radar Operator
13r.description: Nag-o-operate ng mga artillery radar na sinusundan ang mga paparating na bala ng kalaban pabalik sa pinagpaputukan nito para makaganti ang artillery ng kakampi.
13r.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 10 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

13u.title: Field Artillery Recruit
13u.description: Isang field artillery enlistment option: nagte-training ang mga recruit sa mga basics ng artillery, tapos ilalagay sila sa isang partikular na artillery specialty.
13u.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 6-10 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (AIT) depende sa MOS (ayon sa GoArmy)

180a.title: Special Forces Warrant Officer
180a.description: Senior technical at tactical expert sa isang Special Forces team na tumutulong magplano at mamuno sa mga special operations mission.
180a.training: Bukas sa mga kwalipikadong Soldiers (karaniwan ay sergeant pataas sa kaugnay na trabaho); Warrant Officer Candidate School sa Fort Rucker, AL, tapos ang Warrant Officer Basic Course ng branch (ayon sa GoArmy)

18a.title: Special Forces Officer
18a.description: Namumuno sa isang Special Forces team (Green Berets) sa unconventional warfare, pag-training ng mga foreign force at iba pang special operations mission.
18a.training: Ma-commission bilang officer, tapos ang Basic Officer Leader Course (BOLC) para sa branch (ayon sa GoArmy)

18b.title: Special Forces Weapons Sergeant
18b.description: Nagsisilbing weapons expert ng isang Special Forces team, eksperto sa mga armas ng U.S. at ng ibang bansa at nagtuturo sa iba kung paano gamitin ang mga ito.
18b.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 43 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

18x.title: Special Forces Candidate
18x.description: Isang enlistment option para sa mga recruit na gustong sumubok sa Special Forces pagkatapos makumpleto ang infantry at airborne training.
18x.training: 22 linggo ng Infantry One Station Unit Training; 4 na linggong Special Operations Forces Preparation Course at ang Special Forces Assessment & Selection Course, pagkatapos ng Airborne School (ayon sa GoArmy)

19a.title: Armor Officer
19a.description: Namumuno sa mga tank at cavalry unit, nagpaplano ng mounted attack at reconnaissance, at nagko-command ng mga armored vehicle at crew.
19a.training: Ma-commission bilang officer, tapos ang Basic Officer Leader Course (BOLC) para sa branch (ayon sa GoArmy)

19c.title: Bradley Crewmember
19c.description: Bahagi ng crew ng M2/M3 Bradley Fighting Vehicle, nag-o-operate ng mga armas at system nito sa mechanized combat.
19c.training: 18 linggo ng One Station Unit Training, na kasama na ang Basic Combat Training at Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

19d.title: Cavalry Scout
19d.description: Nagsisilbing mata at tenga ng commander, nauunang mag-scout nang naglalakad o nakasakay sa vehicle para mangalap ng impormasyon tungkol sa kalaban at sa terrain.
19d.training: 22 linggo ng One Station Unit Training, na kasama na ang Basic Combat Training at Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

19k.title: Armor Crewmember
19k.description: Bahagi ng crew ng M1 Abrams tank bilang driver, loader, gunner o tank commander, nag-o-operate at nagpapaputok ng main gun nito.
19k.training: 22 linggo ng One Station Unit Training, na kasama na ang Basic Combat Training at Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

19u.title: Armor Crewmember Recruit
19u.description: Isang armor enlistment option: nagte-training ang mga recruit sa mga basics ng tank at cavalry, tapos ilalagay sila sa isang partikular na armor job.
19u.training: 22 linggo ng One Station Unit Training, na kasama na ang Basic Combat Training at Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

37a.title: Psychological Operations Officer
37a.description: Namumuno sa psychological operations, nagpaplano ng mga messaging campaign na nakakaimpluwensya sa mga foreign audience bilang suporta sa mga layunin ng U.S.
37a.training: Ma-commission bilang officer, tapos ang Basic Officer Leader Course (BOLC) para sa branch (ayon sa GoArmy)

37f.title: Psychological Operations Specialist
37f.description: Nagre-research tungkol sa mga foreign audience at gumagawa at naghahatid ng mga mensahe, broadcast at produkto na layong maimpluwensyahan ang kanilang pag-uugali.
37f.training: 20 linggo ng One Station Unit Training; 10-araw na Psychological Operations Specialist Assessment & Selection Program, pagkatapos ng Airborne School at Psychological Operations Specialist Qualification Course (active duty lang); Score na 85 pataas sa Defense Language Aptitude Battery (DLAB) (active duty lang); Active Duty at Army Reserve: 10 linggo ng Basic Combat Training, 10 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training o kaya 16-22 linggo ng One Station Unit Training; Active Duty lang: Airborne School*; 5 linggo ng Psychological Operations (PO) Preparation & Conditioning Course; 10-araw na PO Assessment & Selection; 10 linggo ng PO Qualification Course; 10 linggo ng Special Warfare PO Course; 16-22 linggo ng Basic Special Operations Language Training*; Score na 75 pataas sa Defense Language Aptitude Battery (DLAB); *Puwedeng mag-attend ng Airborne o Language training ang mga Army Reserve Soldiers kung kailangan ito ng kanilang unit. (ayon sa GoArmy)

38a.title: Civil Affairs Officer
38a.description: Namumuno sa mga civil affairs team na nakikipagtulungan sa mga lokal na gobyerno at sibilyan para mabawasan ang gulo at suportahan ang katatagan.
38a.training: Ma-commission bilang officer, tapos ang Basic Officer Leader Course (BOLC) para sa branch (ayon sa GoArmy)

38b.title: Civil Affairs Specialist
38b.description: Nakikipagtulungan sa mga sibilyan, lokal na opisyal at aid group para alamin ang mga pangangailangan at i-coordinate ang suporta habang may military operations.
38b.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 13 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

390a.title: Robotics Technician
390a.description: Bagong-bagong Special Forces warrant officer job (in-activate noong Oct. 2026) na nag-i-integrate, nagpo-program at nagpoprotekta ng mga robotic at autonomous system para sa mga mission.
390a.training: Bukas sa mga kwalipikadong Soldiers (karaniwan ay sergeant pataas sa kaugnay na trabaho); Warrant Officer Candidate School sa Fort Rucker, AL, tapos ang Warrant Officer Basic Course ng branch (ayon sa GoArmy)

74a.title: Chemical, Biological, Radiological And Nuclear (CBRN) Officer
74a.description: Namumuno sa mga chemical, biological, radiological at nuclear defense unit at nagpapayo sa mga commander tungkol sa mga CBRN threat.
74a.training: Ma-commission bilang officer, tapos ang Basic Officer Leader Course (BOLC) para sa branch (ayon sa GoArmy)

89d.title: Explosive Ordnance Disposal (EOD) Specialist
89d.description: Naghahanap, nagkikilala at ligtas na nagdi-dispose ng mga bomba, unexploded ordnance at improvised explosive device.
89d.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 36 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

89e.title: Explosive Ordnance Disposal (EOD) Officer
89e.description: Namumuno sa mga explosive ordnance disposal team na ginagawang ligtas at nagdi-dispose ng mga bomba at iba pang explosive hazard.
89e.training: Ma-commission bilang officer, tapos ang Basic Officer Leader Course (BOLC) para sa branch (ayon sa GoArmy)

120a.title: Construction Engineering Technician
120a.description: Engineer warrant officer na nagpaplano at namamahala ng mga construction project, mula sa mga pasilidad ng base hanggang sa mga kalsada at utilities.
120a.training: Bukas sa mga kwalipikadong Soldiers (karaniwan ay sergeant pataas sa kaugnay na trabaho); Warrant Officer Candidate School sa Fort Rucker, AL, tapos ang Warrant Officer Basic Course ng branch (ayon sa GoArmy)

125d.title: Geospatial Engineering Technician
125d.description: Technical expert na namamahala sa pangangalap at paggawa ng mga mapa at terrain data para sa mga commander.
125d.training: Bukas sa mga kwalipikadong Soldiers (karaniwan ay sergeant pataas sa kaugnay na trabaho); Warrant Officer Candidate School sa Fort Rucker, AL, tapos ang Warrant Officer Basic Course ng branch (ayon sa GoArmy)

12a.title: Engineer Officer
12a.description: Namumuno sa mga engineer unit na gumagawa ng tulay, kalsada at base, naglilinis ng mga obstacle at explosive, at tumutulong sa paggalaw ng mga kakampi habang pinapabagal ang kalaban.
12a.training: Ma-commission bilang officer, tapos ang Basic Officer Leader Course (BOLC) para sa branch (ayon sa GoArmy)

12b.title: Combat Engineer
12b.description: Nililinis ang mga ruta at binubutas ang mga obstacle, humahawak ng mga explosive at mina, at gumagawa ng fighting position para makagalaw at makalaban ang mga combat unit.
12b.training: 14 linggo ng One Station Unit Training, na pinagsasama ang Basic Training at Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

12c.title: Bridge Crewmember
12c.description: Gumagawa at nag-o-operate ng mga assault bridge, floating bridge at balsa para makatawid ang mga tropa at vehicle sa mga ilog at puwang.
12c.training: 14 linggo ng One Station Unit Training, na kasama na ang Basic Combat Training at Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

12d.title: Diver
12d.description: Nagtatrabaho sa ilalim ng tubig sa mga mission ng Army, gumagawa ng salvage, inspection, repair at demolition sa mga daungan, ilog at baybaying tubig.
12d.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 29 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

12g.title: Quarrying Specialist
12g.description: Nagpapatakbo ng quarry operations, nagda-drill at nagpapasabog ng bato, at gumagawa ng durog na bato na ginagamit sa paggawa ng kalsada, airfield at base.
12g.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 29 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

12k.title: Tubero (Plumber)
12k.description: Nag-i-install at nagre-repair ng mga tubo para sa tubig, waste at heating sa mga construction project at pasilidad ng Army.
12k.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 7 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

12n.title: Horizontal Construction Engineer
12n.description: Nag-o-operate ng mabibigat na construction machinery tulad ng bulldozer, grader at scraper para maglipat ng lupa at gumawa ng kalsada, airfield at iba pang proyekto.
12n.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 9 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

12p.title: Prime Power Production Specialist
12p.description: Nag-i-install, nagpapatakbo at nagme-maintain ng malalaking power plant at distribution equipment na nagsu-supply ng kuryente sa mga base at operasyon ng Army.
12p.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 48 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

12q.title: Power Distribution Specialist
12q.description: Gumagawa at nagme-maintain ng mga overhead at underground na linya ng kuryente at ng mga electrical distribution network na nagpapadaloy ng kuryente sa mga site ng Army.
12q.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 9 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

12r.title: Interior Electrician
12r.description: Nag-i-install at nag-aayos ng interior wiring, ilaw at electrical system sa mga gusaling itinayo o ginagamit ng Army.
12r.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 7 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

12t.title: Technical Engineer
12t.description: Nagsu-survey ng lupa, nagsasagawa ng soil at materials test, at gumagawa ng mga construction plan at drawing para sa mga engineering project ng Army.
12t.training: 10 linggo ng Basic Training; 17 linggo ng Advanced Individual Training (ayon sa GoArmy)

12w.title: Carpentry and Masonry Specialist
12w.description: Gumagawa at nagre-repair ng mga istruktura gamit ang kahoy, konkreto, brick at block, mula framing hanggang finishing.

0205.training: Warrant Officer Basic Course; MAGTF Intelligence Operations and Fusion Course, Dam Neck, VA

0210.title: Counterintelligence/Human Source Intelligence (CI/HUMINT) Operations and Sensitive Activities Officer
0210.description: Warrant officer at technical expert na nagpaplano at namamahala ng counterintelligence, human intelligence at sensitive activities.

0231.title: Intelligence Specialist
0231.description: Nangangalap, nag-a-analyze at nagbi-brief ng intelligence tungkol sa kalaban, terrain at panahon para matulungan ang mga commander na magplano ng operations.
0231.training: MAGTF Intelligence Specialist Entry Course, Dam Neck, VA

0241.title: Imagery Analysis Specialist
0241.description: Pinag-aaralan ang mga imahe mula sa satellites, aircraft at drones para hanapin at kilalanin ang mga target at mahahalagang aktibidad.
0241.training: Tactical Imagery Analysis Course, Dam Neck, VA

0261.title: Geospatial Intelligence Specialist
0261.description: Gumagawa ng mga mapa at geospatial intelligence products na nagpapakita ng terrain, mga ruta at features ng isang lugar.
0261.training: Basic Geographic Intelligence Specialist Course, Dam Neck, VA

2602.title: Signals Intelligence/Electromagnetic Warfare Operations Officer
2602.description: Warrant officer na namamahala sa signals intelligence at electronic warfare operations.
2602.training: Warrant Officer Basic Course; SIGINT/EW/Cyberspace Operations Officer Course, Dam Neck, VA

2621.title: Communications Intelligence/Electromagnetic Warfare Operator
2621.description: Nag-i-intercept at nag-a-analyze ng communications ng kalaban at nagsasagawa ng electronic warfare laban sa mga ito.
2621.training: Basic Signals Operators Course at Communications SIGINT Analyst Course, Goodfellow AFB, San Angelo, TX

2631.title: Electronic Intelligence/Electromagnetic Warfare Analyst
2631.description: Nag-a-analyze ng electronic (non-communications) signals tulad ng radar emissions para sa intelligence at electronic warfare.
2631.training: Basic Signals Operators Course at Electronic SIGINT Analyst Course, Goodfellow AFB, San Angelo, TX

2641.title: Cryptologic Language Analyst
2641.description: Ginagamit ang kaalaman sa wikang banyaga para i-monitor, i-transcribe at isalin ang mga na-intercept na communications.
2641.training: Basic Signals Operators Course at language training

2651.title: Intelligence Surveillance Reconnaissance (ISR) Systems Engineer
2651.description: Nag-i-integrate at namamahala ng ISR systems, intelligence data at intelligence networks.
2651.training: Basic SIGINT Operators Course at ISR Engineer Course, San Angelo, TX

4402.title: Judge Advocate
4402.description: Military lawyer na nagpapayo sa mga commander at kumakatawan sa mga kliyente sa courts-martial at iba pang legal na usapin.
4402.training: Basic Lawyer Course, Naval Justice School

4421.title: Legal Services Specialist
4421.description: Nagbibigay ng legal administrative support tulad ng pagproseso ng kaso, research at mga papeles para sa court-martial.
4421.training: Legal Services Specialist Course, Naval Justice School, Newport, RI

4430.title: Legal Administrative Officer
4430.description: Warrant officer na namamahala ng legal administration sa mga law center at legal office.
4430.training: Warrant Officer Basic Course; Army Legal Administrator Warrant Officer Basic Course

0402.title: Logistics Officer
0402.description: Nagpaplano at namamahala ng logistics tulad ng supply, maintenance, transportasyon at engineering support.
0402.training: Logistics Officer Course, Camp Johnson/Camp Lejeune, NC

0408.title: Fatality Management Officer
0408.description: Warrant officer na nagpaplano at nangangasiwa sa pagkuha at pag-aalaga sa mga labi ng mga nasawing service member.

0411.title: Maintenance Management Analyst
0411.description: Sinusubaybayan at ina-analyze ang maintenance ng ground equipment para laging handa ang gamit ng mga unit.
0411.training: Basic Maintenance Management Specialist Course, Camp Lejeune, NC

0441.title: Logistics Specialist
0441.description: Inihahanda ang supplies, gamit at mga tao para sa deployment at tumutulong magplano ng paggalaw ng mga puwersa.
0441.training: Basic Logistics Course, Camp Lejeune, NC

0451.title: Airborne and Air Delivery Specialist
0451.description: Nag-iimpake at nagme-maintain ng parachutes at inihahanda ang supplies at equipment para i-air-drop sa mga tropa.
0451.training: Army Airborne Course at Parachute Rigger Course

0471.title: Personnel Retrieval and Processing Specialist
0471.description: Naghahanap, kumukuha, kumikilala at humahawak nang may dignidad sa mga labi ng mga nasawing service member.

3002.title: Ground Supply Officer
3002.description: Namamahala ng supplies, accountability ng equipment at supply chain ng isang command.
3002.training: Supply Chain Management Officer Course, Camp Lejeune, NC

3010.title: Ground Supply Chain Management Officer
3010.description: Warrant officer at technical expert na nangangasiwa sa operations ng supply section.
3010.training: Supply Chain Management Officer at Intermediate Supply Operations Courses; Warrant Officer Basic Course

3043.title: Supply Chain Specialist
3043.description: Namamahala ng inventories at supply records para makarating ang tamang supplies sa mga unit kapag kailangan nila.
3043.training: Supply Chain Management Basic Course, Camp Lejeune, NC

3051.title: Inventory Management Specialist
3051.description: Tumatanggap, nag-iimbak, nagbabantay at namimigay ng supplies sa mga warehouse at supply point.
3051.training: Inventory Management Basic Course, Camp Lejeune, NC

3152.title: Distribution Specialist
3152.description: Nagpaplano at namamahala ng pagpapadala at paglipat ng personnel, cargo at household goods.
3152.training: Distribution Specialist Basic Course, Camp Lejeune, NC

5803.title: Military Police Officer
5803.description: Namumuno sa mga military police unit sa law enforcement at security operations.
5803.training: Military Police Officers Basic Course, Fort Leonard Wood, MO

5804.title: Corrections Officer
5804.description: Warrant officer na nangangasiwa sa pagbabantay at pag-aalaga sa mga bilanggo sa correctional facilities.

5805.title: Criminal Investigation Officer
5805.description: Warrant officer na namamahala sa isang opisina ng Criminal Investigation Division.

5811.title: Military Police
5811.description: Gumagawa ng law enforcement at security duties sa mga base at sumusuporta sa security sa field.
5811.training: Basic Military Police Course, Fort Leonard Wood, MO

5831.title: Correction and Detention Specialist
5831.description: Nagbabantay at nangangasiwa sa mga bilanggo sa military correctional facilities.
5831.training: Corrections and Detention Specialist Course, Fort Leonard Wood, MO

3510.title: Motor Transport Officer
3510.description: Warrant officer na nagpaplano at nangangasiwa sa motor transport operations at maintenance.
3510.training: Warrant Officer Basic Course; Motor Transport Maintenance Officers Course

3521.title: Automotive Maintenance Technician
3521.description: Nagse-service at nagkukumpuni ng mga truck, Humvee at iba pang motor transport vehicles.
3521.training: Automotive Maintenance Technician Basic Course, Camp Lejeune, NC

3531.title: Motor Vehicle Operator
3531.description: Nagmamaneho ng medium at heavy tactical trucks para maghatid ng mga tropa, supplies at equipment.
3531.training: Basic Motor Vehicle Operators Course, U.S. Army Engineer School, Fort Leonard Wood, MO

5512.title: Member, "The Commandant's Own," U.S. Marine Drum & Bugle Corps
5512.description: Nagtatanghal kasama ang 'The Commandant's Own' U.S. Marine Drum & Bugle Corps sa mga seremonya at pampublikong event.

5524.title: Musikero
5524.description: Tumutugtog sa isang Marine Corps band sa mga concert, parada at seremonya.

2110.title: Ordnance Vehicle Maintenance Officer
2110.description: Warrant officer na namamahala sa maintenance ng armored at ordnance vehicles.
2110.training: Ground Ordnance Maintenance Officer Course; Warrant Officer Basic Course

2111.title: Small Arms Repairer/Technician
2111.description: Nag-iinspect, nagme-maintain at nagkukumpuni ng small arms tulad ng rifles, machine guns at pistols.

2120.title: Ground Ordnance Maintenance Officer
2120.description: Warrant officer na namamahala sa kahandaan, accountability at security ng ground ordnance equipment.
2120.training: Ground Ordnance Maintenance Officer Course; Warrant Officer Basic Course

2131.title: Artillery Systems Technician
2131.description: Nagme-maintain at nagkukumpuni ng towed artillery howitzers.

2141.title: Assault Amphibious Vehicle (AAV)/Assault Combat Vehicle (ACV) Repairer/Technician
2141.description: Nagme-maintain at nagkukumpuni ng automotive systems ng AAV at ACV amphibious vehicles.
2141.training: AAV Repairer Basic Course o ACV Basic Repairer Course, Camp Pendleton, CA

2143.title: Amphibious Combat Vehicle (ACV) Technician
2143.description: Nagme-maintain at nagkukumpuni ng mga sasakyan sa Amphibious Combat Vehicle family.
2143.training: Amphibious Combat Vehicle Basic Repairer Course

2147.title: Light Armored Vehicle (LAV) Repairer/Technician
2147.description: Nagme-maintain at nagkukumpuni ng Light Armored Vehicles (LAVs).
2147.training: Light Armored Vehicle Repair Marine Course

2171.title: Electro-Optical Ordnance Repairer
2171.description: Nagkukumpuni ng night vision devices, lasers, optics at fire-control equipment.

2311.title: Ammunition Technician
2311.description: Tumatanggap, nag-iimbak, namimigay at humahawak ng ammunition at explosives.

0511.title: MAGTF Planning Specialist
0511.description: Sumusuporta sa deployment at force planning, sinusubaybayan ang mga unit at requirements sa planning systems.
0511.training: MAGTF Planners Basic Course, Dam Neck, VA

4502.title: Communication Strategy and Operations Officer
4502.description: Namumuno sa public affairs at communication strategy, nakikipag-ugnayan sa media at sa publiko.
4502.training: Public Affairs Communication Strategy Qualification Course, DINFOS, Fort Meade, MD

4503.title: Visual Information Officer
4503.description: Warrant officer at eksperto sa visual information tulad ng paggawa ng photo, video at graphics.

4512.title: Combat Graphics Specialist
4512.description: Nagdidisenyo ng graphics, layouts at visual products para sa communication ng Marine Corps.
4512.training: Mass Communication Foundations (Graphic Design) Course, DINFOS, Fort Meade, MD

4541.title: Combat Photographer
4541.description: Kumukuha at gumagawa ng mga litrato na nagdodokumento ng operations at mga event ng Marine Corps.
4541.training: Mass Communication Foundations (Photography) Course, DINFOS, Fort Meade, MD

4571.title: Combat Videographer
4571.description: Nagfi-film at nag-e-edit ng video na nagdodokumento ng operations ng Marine Corps at nagkukuwento ng kanilang istorya.
4571.training: Mass Communication Foundations (Videography) Course, DINFOS, Fort Meade, MD

6842.title: METOC Analyst Forecaster
6842.description: Nag-o-observe, nag-a-analyze at nagfo-forecast ng kondisyon ng panahon at karagatan para sa military operations.
6842.training: METOC Analyst Forecaster Courses, Keesler AFB, MS

1650.title: Public Affairs Officer
1650.description: Namumuno sa communications, media relations at community outreach ng Navy.
1650.training: Officer Candidate School, tapos ang Public Affairs qualification course sa Defense Information School.

mc.title: Mass Communication Specialist
mc.description: Ikinukuwento ang istorya ng Navy sa pamamagitan ng photography, video, pagsusulat at graphic design, at humahawak ng public affairs at media products.
mc.training: Boot camp, tapos 'A' School sa Defense Information School, Fort George G. Meade, MD.

mu.title: Musikero
mu.description: Tumutugtog sa mga Navy band sa mga seremonya, community event at morale functions sa buong mundo.
mu.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 21 linggo ng 'A' School sa Naval School of Music, Virginia Beach, VA (kailangan ng audition).

aircraft-handling-officer.title: Aircraft Handling Officer
aircraft-handling-officer.description: Senior aviation officer na nagdidirekta sa paggalaw at paglalagay ng bawat aircraft sa flight deck at hangar ng isang carrier.
aircraft-handling-officer.training: Hindi ito entry job; naaabot ito pagkatapos ng mga naunang aviation officer tour.

catapult-officer.title: Catapult Officer
catapult-officer.description: Flight deck officer na nangangasiwa sa catapult launches at nagbibigay ng huling signal para ilunsad ang mga jet mula sa carrier.
catapult-officer.training: Officer Candidate School, air indoctrination sa Pensacola, FL, tapos aviation maintenance training.

1310.title: Fighter Pilot (Naval Aviator - Jet)
1310.description: Naval aviator na nagpapalipad ng strike fighter jets mula sa mga aircraft carrier para sa air combat at strike missions.
1310.training: OCS (o Academy/ROTC), air indoctrination sa Pensacola, FL, primary flight training, tapos ang jet pipeline.

1310-fixed-wing-pilot-naval-aviator.title: Fixed Wing Pilot (Naval Aviator)
1310-fixed-wing-pilot-naval-aviator.description: Naval aviator na nagpapalipad ng propeller at multi-engine aircraft para sa patrol, anti-submarine, early warning at logistics missions.
1310-fixed-wing-pilot-naval-aviator.training: OCS, air indoctrination sa Pensacola, FL, primary flight training, tapos isang fixed-wing pipeline.

1310-helicopter-pilot-naval-aviator.title: Helicopter Pilot (Naval Aviator)
1310-helicopter-pilot-naval-aviator.description: Naval aviator na nagpapalipad ng helicopters para sa anti-submarine warfare, search and rescue, logistics at special operations support.
1310-helicopter-pilot-naval-aviator.training: OCS, air indoctrination sa Pensacola, FL, primary flight training, tapos ang helicopter pipeline.

1320.title: Naval Flight Officer
1320.description: Aircrew officer na nagpapatakbo ng navigation, sensors, communications at weapons systems sa mga Navy aircraft at madalas na nangunguna sa mission.
1320.training: OCS, air indoctrination sa Pensacola, FL, primary flight training, tapos isang aircraft-specific pipeline.

1520.title: Aviation Maintenance Duty Officer
1520.description: Namamahala ng aircraft maintenance programs, repair facilities at mga Sailor na nagpapanatiling lumilipad ang mga aircraft.
1520.training: Officer Candidate School, 6-linggong air indoctrination course, tapos Aviation Maintenance Officer School sa Pensacola, FL.

737x.title: Air Vehicle Pilot
737x.description: Warrant officer na nagpapalipad ng carrier-based unmanned aircraft ng Navy, tulad ng MQ-25 Stingray refueling drone.
737x.training: Officer Candidate School, appointment bilang Warrant Officer 1, tapos mga 15-18 buwan ng flight at MQ-25 training.

abe.title: Aviation Boatswain's Mate - Launch & Recovery
abe.description: Nagpapatakbo at nagme-maintain ng catapults at arresting gear na naglulunsad at sumasalo sa mga jet sa aircraft carriers.
abe.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 5 linggo ng 'A' School sa Pensacola, FL.

abf.title: Aviation Boatswain's Mate - Fuel
abf.description: Nag-o-operate at nagme-maintain ng aviation fuel systems at nagre-refuel ng aircraft sa mga carrier at amphibious ship.
abf.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 6 na linggo ng 'A' School sa Pensacola, FL.

abh.title: Aviation Boatswain's Mate - Aircraft Handling
abh.description: Inililipat at pinupuwesto ang mga aircraft sa flight decks at hangar bays, at namumuno sa crash, fire at rescue response.
abh.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 4 na linggo ng 'A' School sa Pensacola, FL.

ac.title: Air Traffic Controller
ac.description: Nagdidirekta sa mga aircraft na nagte-take off, lumalapag at gumagalaw sa controlled airspace mula sa towers, radar rooms at carrier control centers.
ac.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 15 linggo ng 'A' School sa Pensacola, FL.

ao.title: Aviation Ordnanceman
ao.description: Nag-iimbak, nag-iinspect, nag-a-assemble at nagkakarga ng bombs, missiles, rockets at ammunition sa mga Navy aircraft.
ao.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 9 na linggo ng 'A' School sa Pensacola, FL.

awf.title: Naval Aircrewman Mechanical
awf.description: Nagsisilbing in-flight technician at crew member na nagmo-monitor ng aircraft systems, humahawak ng cargo at pasahero, at sumusuporta sa maintenance.
awf.training: Boot camp, tapos Aircrew Candidate School sa Pensacola, FL, kasama ang follow-on aircrew training.

awo.title: Naval Aircrewman Operator
awo.description: Nag-o-operate ng sensors at mission systems sakay ng maritime patrol aircraft para hanapin at i-track ang mga submarine at surface threats.
awo.training: Boot camp, tapos 'A' School sa Pensacola, FL, kasama ang aircrew training.

awr.title: Naval Aircrewman Tactical Helicopter
awr.description: Crew ng MH-60R Seahawk helicopters, nagpapatakbo ng sensors para tugisin ang mga submarine at nagku-qualify din bilang rescue swimmer.
awr.training: Boot camp, Aircrew Candidate School at Rescue Swimmer School sa Pensacola, FL, tapos follow-on training.

aws.title: Naval Aircrewman Helicopter
aws.description: Lumilipad bilang crew member ng helicopter, humahawak ng mga gawain tulad ng search and rescue, logistics, gunnery at iba pang mission systems.
aws.training: Boot camp, tapos Aircrew Candidate School sa Pensacola, FL, kasama ang follow-on aircrew training.

awv.title: Naval Aircrewman Avionics
awv.description: Lumilipad bilang crew member na nag-o-operate at nagta-troubleshoot ng avionics, sonar at communications gear habang may mission.
awv.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 19 na linggo ng Aircrew Candidate School at AWV 'A' School sa Pensacola, FL.

1200.title: Human Resources Officer
1200.description: Namamahala ng manpower, personnel policy, recruiting at training programs para sa Navy.
1200.training: Officer Development School (5 linggo) sa Newport, RI.

3100.title: Supply Corps Officer
3100.description: Nagpapatakbo ng logistics, supply chains, contracting at financial management ng Navy.
3100.training: Officer Candidate School sa Newport, RI, tapos Supply Corps officer training.

az.title: Aviation Maintenance Administrationman
az.description: Hawak ang records, schedules at mga papeles na sumusubaybay sa maintenance ng mga Navy aircraft.
az.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 8 linggo ng 'A' School sa Meridian, MS.

cs.title: Culinary Specialist
cs.description: Nagpaplano ng menu, nagluluto at naghahain ng pagkain para sa mga Sailor, at nagpapatakbo ng galleys at officer messes; ang submarine version ay CSS.
cs.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 5 linggo ng 'A' School sa Fort Lee, VA; ang mga submarine CSS ay pumapasok din sa Basic Enlisted Submarine School sa Groton, CT.

ls.title: Logistics Specialist
ls.description: Nag-o-order, nag-iimbak at nagta-track ng parts at supplies, humahawak ng kaugnay na finances at nagpapatakbo ng postal operations; ang submarine version ay LSS.
ls.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 9 na linggo ng 'A' School sa Meridian, MS; ang mga LSS ay pumapasok din sa Basic Enlisted Submarine School.

nc.title: Navy Counselor
nc.description: Mga senior enlisted career counselor at recruiter na nagpapayo sa mga Sailor tungkol sa career options at tumutulong magpasok ng mga tao sa Navy.
nc.training: Conversion rating para sa mga experienced petty officer; hindi direct-entry job.

ps.title: Personnel Specialist
ps.description: Humahawak ng sweldo, personnel records, travel claims at iba pang administrative career actions ng mga Sailor.
ps.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 5 linggo ng 'A' School sa Meridian, MS.

rs.title: Retail Services Specialist
rs.description: Nagpapatakbo ng ship stores, vending, laundry at barber services na sumusuporta sa morale ng crew (dating tinatawag na Ship's Serviceman).
rs.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 5 linggo ng 'A' School sa Meridian, MS.

yn.title: Yeoman
yn.description: Gumagawa ng office at administrative work tulad ng correspondence, records at official reports para sa mga command; ang submarine version ay YNS.
yn.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 7 linggo ng 'A' School sa Meridian, MS; ang mga YNS ay pumapasok din sa Basic Enlisted Submarine School.

5100.title: Civil Engineer Corps Officer
5100.description: Engineer officer na nagpaplano at namamahala ng construction at facilities ng Navy, at namumuno sa mga Seabee unit.
5100.training: Officer Candidate School sa Newport, RI, tapos CEC officer training.

bu.title: Builder
bu.description: Isang Seabee na nagtatayo at nagkukumpuni ng mga istruktura gamit ang skills sa carpentry, masonry, concrete at roofing.
bu.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 10 linggo ng 'A' School sa Gulfport, MS.

ce.title: Construction Electrician
ce.description: Isang Seabee na nag-i-install at nagkukumpuni ng electrical power, wiring at distribution systems, kasama ang trabahong pag-akyat sa poste.
ce.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 20 linggo ng 'A' School sa Sheppard AFB, TX.

cm.title: Construction Mechanic
cm.description: Isang Seabee na nagme-maintain at nagkukumpuni ng mga truck, heavy construction equipment at ng mga makina nito.
cm.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 16 na linggo ng 'A' School sa Port Hueneme, CA.

ea.title: Engineering Aide
ea.description: Isang Seabee na gumagawa ng surveying, drafting, materials testing at planning bago magsimula ang construction.
ea.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 15 linggo ng 'A' School sa Fort Leonard Wood, MO.

eo.title: Equipment Operator
eo.description: Isang Seabee na nagmamaneho at nag-o-operate ng heavy machinery tulad ng bulldozers, graders, cranes at trucks.
eo.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 11 linggo ng 'A' School sa Fort Leonard Wood, MO.

sw.title: Steelworker
sw.description: Isang Seabee na gumagawa, nagwe-weld at nagtatayo ng steel structures, tulay at iba pang metal work.
sw.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 11 linggo ng 'A' School sa Gulfport, MS.

ut.title: Utilitiesman
ut.description: Isang Seabee na nag-i-install at nagme-maintain ng plumbing, heating, air conditioning, water at wastewater systems.
ut.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 13 linggo ng 'A' School sa Sheppard AFB, TX.

at.title: Aviation Electronics Technician
at.description: Nagme-maintain at nagkukumpuni ng aircraft electronics tulad ng radar, navigation, communications at weapons systems.
at.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 19 na linggo ng 'A' School sa Pensacola, FL.

et.title: Electronics Technician
et.description: Nagme-maintain at nagkukumpuni ng shipboard electronics tulad ng radars, communications gear at navigation systems.
et.training: Boot camp, tapos Apprentice Technical Training sa Great Lakes, IL, kasunod ang specialty training.

etv.title: Electronics Technician Navigation (Submarines)
etv.description: Nag-o-operate at nagme-maintain ng navigation at ship-control electronics ng submarine at tumutulong i-plot ang ruta nito.
etv.training: Boot camp, Basic Enlisted Submarine School, tapos 'A' School at pipeline training sa Groton, CT.

fc.title: Fire Controlman
fc.description: Nag-o-operate at nagme-maintain ng radar, computer at weapons-control systems sa mga surface warship, kasama ang Aegis (FCA).
fc.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 31 linggo ng Apprentice Technical Training at FC strand training sa Great Lakes, IL.

ft.title: Fire Control Technician
ft.description: Nagme-maintain at nag-o-operate ng mga computer at electronics na kumokontrol sa torpedoes at missiles ng submarine.
ft.training: Boot camp, Basic Enlisted Submarine School, tapos mga 18 linggo ng 'A' School at pipeline training sa Groton, CT.

ic.title: Interior Communications Electrician
ic.description: Nag-i-install at nagkukumpuni ng internal communication systems ng barko, mula alarms at phones hanggang entertainment at navigation gear.
ic.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 21 linggo ng technical at 'A' School training sa Great Lakes, IL.

it.title: Information Systems Technician
it.description: Nagpapatakbo at nagse-secure ng shipboard at shore computer networks, communications circuits at IT systems.
it.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 24 na linggo ng 'A' School sa Pensacola, FL (Groton, CT para sa mga submarine IT).

ite.title: Information Systems Technician Submarines - Electronic Warfare
ite.description: Submarine IT specialist na nagpapatakbo ng electronic warfare at signal-detection equipment.
ite.training: Basic Enlisted Submarine School at 'A' School sa Groton, CT, tapos ang electronic warfare pipeline.

itn.title: Information Systems Technician Submarines - Network
itn.description: Submarine IT specialist na namamahala at nagdedepensa ng computer networks ng submarine.
itn.training: Basic Enlisted Submarine School at 'A' School sa Groton, CT, tapos ang network pipeline.

itr.title: Information Systems Technician Submarines - Communications
itr.description: Submarine IT specialist na nag-o-operate at nagme-maintain ng radio at communications systems.
itr.training: Basic Enlisted Submarine School at 'A' School sa Groton, CT, tapos ang communications pipeline.

mt.title: Missile Technician
mt.description: Nagme-maintain, nagte-test at nagkakarga ng ballistic missiles na dala ng mga Navy submarine.
mt.training: Boot camp, Basic Enlisted Submarine School at mechanical skills training sa Groton, CT, tapos MT 'A' School.

rw.title: Robotics Warfare Specialist
rw.description: Nag-o-operate at nagme-maintain ng robotic at autonomous systems, kasama ang kanilang autonomy software, data at AI components.
rw.training: Conversion-only rating para sa mga kasalukuyang Sailor (E-4 hanggang E-9) na may unmanned-systems NECs; hindi direct-entry job.

dc.title: Damage Controlman
dc.description: Bumbero at emergency responder sa barko na humahawak ng sunog, pagbaha at chemical, biological at radiological defense.
dc.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 10 linggo ng Basic Engineering Common Core at 'A' School sa Great Lakes, IL.

ma.title: Master-at-Arms
ma.description: Pulis at security force ng Navy: nagpapatupad ng batas, nagbabantay ng mga base at barko, gumagawa ng antiterrorism work at humahawak ng military working dogs.
ma.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 9 na linggo ng 'A' School sa San Antonio, TX.

ad.title: Aviation Machinist's Mate
ad.description: Nagme-maintain at nagkukumpuni ng jet engines, propellers at kaugnay na mechanical systems ng aircraft.
ad.training: Boot camp, tapos core 'A' School sa Pensacola, FL, kasama ang aircraft-specific strand training.

ae.title: Aviation Electrician's Mate
ae.description: Nagme-maintain ng electrical systems ng aircraft kasama ang power generation, lighting, instruments at flight controls.
ae.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 13 linggo ng 'A' School sa Pensacola, FL.

am.title: Aviation Structural Mechanic
am.description: Nagkukumpuni ng airframes, skins, hydraulics at landing gear ng aircraft.
am.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 9 na linggo ng 'A' School sa Pensacola, FL.

ame.title: Aviation Structural Mechanic - Safety Equipment
ame.description: Nagme-maintain ng ejection seats, oxygen systems at iba pang life-saving equipment ng aircraft.
ame.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 9 na linggo ng 'A' School sa Pensacola, FL.

as.title: Aviation Support Equipment Technician
as.description: Nagme-maintain ng ground support gear na ginagamit sa pag-service ng aircraft, tulad ng tow tractors, generators at air conditioners.
as.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 17 linggo ng 'A' School sa Pensacola, FL.

bm.title: Boatswain's Mate
bm.description: Humahawak ng deck seamanship: mooring, anchoring, small boats, rigging, cargo handling at underway replenishment.
bm.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 5 linggo ng 'A' School sa Great Lakes, IL.

em.title: Electrician's Mate
em.description: Nag-o-operate at nagkukumpuni ng electrical generators, power distribution, motors at lighting ng barko.
em.training: Boot camp, tapos Basic Engineering Common Core at electrical training sa Great Lakes, IL.

en.title: Engineman
en.description: Nagme-maintain ng diesel engines, boats, refrigeration at auxiliary machinery sa mga barko.
en.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 14 na linggo ng Basic Engineering Common Core at 'A' School sa Great Lakes, IL.

gm.title: Gunner's Mate
gm.description: Nagme-maintain at nag-o-operate ng naval guns, missile launchers at small arms, at namamahala ng ammunition.
gm.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 15 linggo ng 'A' School sa Great Lakes, IL.

gse.title: Gas Turbine Systems Technician - Electrical
gse.description: Nagme-maintain ng electrical at electronic controls ng gas turbine engines na nagpapatakbo sa maraming barko ng Navy.
gse.training: Boot camp, tapos Basic Engineering Common Core at 'A' School sa Great Lakes, IL.

gsm.title: Gas Turbine Systems Technician - Mechanical
gsm.description: Nag-o-operate at nagkukumpuni ng mechanical na bahagi ng shipboard gas turbine engines at ng mga auxiliary nito.
gsm.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 15 linggo ng Basic Engineering Common Core at 'A' School sa Great Lakes, IL.

ht.title: Hull Maintenance Technician
ht.description: Nagwe-weld, nagpuputol at nagkukumpuni ng ship structures at plumbing, at tumutulong sa damage control.
ht.training: Boot camp, tapos Basic Engineering Common Core at 'A' School kasama ang HT strand training sa Great Lakes, IL.

mm.title: Machinist's Mate
mm.description: Nag-o-operate at nagme-maintain ng propulsion plants, pumps, compressors, air conditioning at iba pang makinarya ng barko.
mm.training: Boot camp, tapos Basic Engineering Common Core at 'A' School sa Great Lakes, IL.

mma.title: Machinist's Mate Auxiliary (Submarines)
mma.description: Nagme-maintain ng auxiliary systems ng submarine tulad ng atmosphere control, hydraulics, refrigeration at air.
mma.training: Boot camp, Basic Enlisted Submarine School at Machinist's Mate 'A' School sa Groton, CT.

mn.title: Mineman
mn.description: Nag-a-assemble, nagte-test at naglalatag ng sea mines at nag-o-operate ng mine-hunting sonar at equipment.
mn.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 19-linggong 'A' School sa Point Loma, CA.

mr.title: Machinery Repairman
mr.description: Gumagamit ng mga machine-shop tool tulad ng lathe at mill para gumawa at mag-ayos ng mga pamalit na piyesa sa barko.
mr.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 18-linggong Engineering Common Core at 'A' School sa Great Lakes, IL.

pr.title: Aircrew Survival Equipmentman
pr.description: Nag-iimpake ng mga parachute at nagme-maintain ng flight gear, life raft at survival equipment para sa mga aircrew.
pr.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 12-linggong core at strand 'A' School sa Pensacola, FL.

tm.title: Torpedoman's Mate
tm.description: Nagme-maintain at humahawak ng mga torpedo at iba pang armas at launch system sa loob ng submarine.
tm.training: Boot camp, Basic Enlisted Submarine School sa Groton, CT, tapos advanced technical training.

1110.title: Surface Warfare Officer
1110.description: Namumuno sa mga Sailors sakay ng mga surface warship at nagsisikap na makapagmaneho at makapag-command ng barko.
1110.training: Commission sa pamamagitan ng OCS, Naval Academy o ROTC, tapos SWO basic training bago mag-report sa barko.

1810.title: Cryptologic Warfare Officer
1810.description: Namumuno sa signals intelligence, electronic warfare, cyber at mga cryptologic operation na may kinalaman sa space.
1810.training: Officer Candidate School, tapos ang 8-linggong Information Warfare Basic Course sa Pensacola, FL.

1820.title: Communications Systems Warfare Officer
1820.description: Nagpapatakbo ng command-and-control network, communications at IT system ng Navy para ligtas na makapagbahagi ng impormasyon ang mga commander (dating Information Professional).
1820.training: Officer Candidate School sa Newport, RI, tapos isang Information Warfare training pipeline.

1830.title: Intelligence Officer
1830.description: Namumuno sa pag-analyze at pag-brief ng intelligence tungkol sa mga kalaban para suportahan ang operational planning.
1830.training: Officer Candidate School, tapos isang basic intelligence course na humigit-kumulang limang buwan sa Dam Neck, VA.

1840.title: Cyber Warfare Engineer
1840.description: Officer na may technical background na gumagawa ng mga cyber tool at capability para sa offensive at defensive na operasyon.
1840.training: Officer Development School sa Newport, RI, tapos assignment sa isang Navy Information Operations Command.

1880.title: Maritime Cyber Warfare Officer
1880.description: Namumuno sa offensive at defensive na cyberspace operations para protektahan ang mga network ng Navy at guluhin ang mga kalaban.

cti.title: Cryptologic Technician (Interpretive)
cti.description: Linguist na nagta-translate at nag-a-analyze ng mga komunikasyon sa banyagang wika para sa intelligence.
cti.training: Boot camp, tapos language training sa Defense Language Institute, Monterey, CA (humigit-kumulang 27-64 na linggo).

ctm.title: Cryptologic Technician (Maintenance)
ctm.description: Nag-i-install at nag-aayos ng mga cryptologic at signals-intelligence na computer at electronic system.
ctm.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 13-linggong 'A' School sa Pensacola, FL.

ctr.title: Cryptologic Technician (Collection)
ctr.description: Nangongolekta at nag-a-analyze ng mga banyagang communications signal para makabuo ng intelligence.
ctr.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 18-linggong 'A' School sa Pensacola, FL.

ctt.title: Cryptologic Technician (Technical)
ctt.description: Nag-a-analyze ng radar at iba pang electronic signal at nagsasagawa ng electronic warfare.
ctt.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 12-linggong 'A' School sa Pensacola, FL.

cwt.title: Cyber Warfare Technician
cwt.description: Nagsasagawa ng defensive at offensive na cyber operations, nag-a-analyze ng mga network at kumokontra sa mga digital na banta.
cwt.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 23-linggong 'A' School sa Pensacola, FL.

is.title: Intelligence Specialist
is.description: Nangangalap, nag-a-analyze at nagbi-brief ng intelligence tungkol sa mga puwersa ng kalaban at mga banta para suportahan ang mga operasyon.
is.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 13-linggong 'A' School sa Dam Neck, VA.

os.title: Operations Specialist
os.description: Nagtatrabaho sa combat information center ng barko: nagpapatakbo ng radar, nagta-track ng mga contact at tumutulong mag-coordinate ng tactical operations.
os.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 10-linggong 'A' School sa Great Lakes, IL.

qm.title: Quartermaster
qm.description: Tumutulong mag-navigate ng mga surface ship sa pag-plot ng ruta, pagbabantay sa bridge at pag-iingat ng mga chart at log.
qm.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 9-linggong 'A' School sa Great Lakes, IL.

stg.title: Sonar Technician (Surface)
stg.description: Nag-o-operate at nagme-maintain ng sonar ng surface ship para matukoy at ma-track ang mga submarine at iba pang contact sa ilalim ng tubig.
stg.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 10-linggong 'A' School sa San Diego, CA, kasama ang isang advanced operator course.

sts.title: Sonar Technician (Submarines)
sts.description: Nag-o-operate at nagme-maintain ng mga sonar system ng submarine para makinig at mag-track ng mga contact.
sts.training: Boot camp, Basic Enlisted Submarine School, tapos sonar 'A' School at pipeline training sa Groton, CT.

2500.title: Judge Advocate General's Corps Officer
2500.description: Abogado ng Navy na nagpo-prosecute at nagdedepensa sa mga court-martial at nagpapayo tungkol sa military, international at administrative law.
2500.training: Officer Development School, tapos isang 10-linggong course sa Naval Justice School, Newport, RI.

ln.title: Legalman
ln.description: Paralegal na sumusuporta sa mga abogado ng Navy sa mga court-martial, legal assistance at administrative law na kaso.
ln.training: Boot camp, tapos isang 11-linggong course sa Naval Justice School, Newport, RI.

2100.title: Doktor (Medical Corps)
2100.description: Doktor na nagbibigay ng medikal at surgical na pangangalaga sa mga service member sa mga ospital, sa barko at kasama ng mga operational unit.
2100.training: Officer Development School pagkatapos ng medical school, tapos internship/residency kung kailangan.

2200.title: Dentista (Dental Corps)
2200.description: Nagbibigay ng dental care sa mga Sailors at Marines sa mga clinic, sa barko at kasama ng mga field unit.
2200.training: Officer Development School pagkatapos ng dental school.

2300-aerospace-operational-physiologist.title: Aerospace & Operational Physiologist
2300-aerospace-operational-physiologist.description: Medical Service Corps officer na nagtuturo sa aircrew tungkol sa pisikal na stress ng paglipad at sa survival.
2300-aerospace-operational-physiologist.training: Officer Development School, tapos aviation at physiology training.

2300.title: Aerospace Experimental Psychologist
2300.description: Medical Service Corps scientist na nag-aaral ng human performance sa aviation at tumutulong mag-design ng aircraft system at training.
2300.training: Officer Development School, tapos flight at specialty training.

2300-audiologist.title: Audiologist
2300-audiologist.description: Medical Service Corps officer na nagte-test ng pandinig, gumagamot ng mga problema sa pandinig at nagpapatakbo ng mga hearing conservation program.
2300-audiologist.training: Officer Development School sa Newport, RI.

2300-clinical-psychologist.title: Clinical Psychologist
2300-clinical-psychologist.description: Nagbibigay ng mental health assessment at therapy para sa mga service member at kanilang pamilya.
2300-clinical-psychologist.training: Officer Development School; may ilang pumapasok sa pamamagitan ng mga graduate o internship program na pinopondohan ng Navy.

2300-environmental-health-officer.title: Environmental Health Officer
2300-environmental-health-officer.description: Pinoprotektahan ang mga tauhan mula sa mga panganib sa kapaligiran at sakit sa pamamagitan ng mga inspection at health surveillance.
2300-environmental-health-officer.training: Officer Development School sa Newport, RI.

2300-health-care-administrator.title: Health Care Administrator
2300-health-care-administrator.description: Nagma-manage ng business side ng Navy medicine, tulad ng finance, operations at information systems.
2300-health-care-administrator.training: Officer Development School sa Newport, RI.

2300-industrial-hygiene-officer.title: Industrial Hygiene Officer
2300-industrial-hygiene-officer.description: Hinahanap at kinokontrol ang mga panganib sa workplace tulad ng ingay, kemikal at radiation para manatiling ligtas ang mga tauhan.
2300-industrial-hygiene-officer.training: Officer Development School sa Newport, RI.

2300-medical-technologist.title: Medical Technologist
2300-medical-technologist.description: Nagpapatakbo ng mga clinical laboratory at blood bank na sumusuporta sa diagnosis at paggamot.
2300-medical-technologist.training: Officer Development School sa Newport, RI.

2300-occupational-therapist.title: Occupational Therapist
2300-occupational-therapist.description: Tinutulungan ang mga pasyente na maibalik ang kakayahan sa pang-araw-araw na buhay pagkatapos ng injury o sakit sa pamamagitan ng rehabilitation therapy.
2300-occupational-therapist.training: Officer Development School sa Newport, RI.

2300-optometrist.title: Optometrist
2300-optometrist.description: Nagbibigay ng eye exam, vision care at paggamot sa mga kondisyon ng mata.
2300-optometrist.training: Officer Development School sa Newport, RI.

2300-pharmacist.title: Pharmacist
2300-pharmacist.description: Nagma-manage ng pharmacy services at kaligtasan sa gamot sa mga treatment facility ng Navy.
2300-pharmacist.training: Officer Development School sa Newport, RI.

2300-physical-therapist.title: Physical Therapist
2300-physical-therapist.description: Gumagamot ng mga musculoskeletal injury at tinutulungan ang mga service member na mabawi ang lakas at galaw nila.
2300-physical-therapist.training: Officer Development School sa Newport, RI.

2300-physician-assistant.title: Physician Assistant
2300-physician-assistant.description: Nagda-diagnose at gumagamot ng mga pasyente bilang licensed provider na katuwang ng mga doktor ng Navy.
2300-physician-assistant.training: Officer Development School sa Newport, RI.

2300-podiatrist.title: Podiatrist
2300-podiatrist.description: Nagda-diagnose at gumagamot ng mga kondisyon sa paa at bukung-bukong.
2300-podiatrist.training: Officer Development School sa Newport, RI.

2300-radiation-health-officer.title: Radiation Health Officer
2300-radiation-health-officer.description: Nangangasiwa sa mga radiation safety program, lalo na para sa mga nuclear-powered na barko at mga medical facility.
2300-radiation-health-officer.training: Officer Development School, tapos radiation health training.

2300-registered-dietitian.title: Registered Dietitian
2300-registered-dietitian.description: Medical Service Corps officer na nagma-manage ng nutrition care at mga food service program.
2300-registered-dietitian.training: Officer Development School sa Newport, RI.

2300-research-biochemist-forensic-toxico.title: Research Biochemist & Forensic Toxicologist
2300-research-biochemist-forensic-toxico.description: Scientist na gumagawa ng lab research at forensic drug testing na sumusuporta sa kalusugan at kaligtasan ng mga service member.

2300-research-physiologist.title: Research Physiologist
2300-research-physiologist.description: Pinag-aaralan kung paano tumutugon ang katawan sa matinding military environment tulad ng diving, altitude at init.
2300-research-physiologist.training: Officer Development School sa Newport, RI.

2300-research-psychologist.title: Research Psychologist
2300-research-psychologist.description: Nire-research ang ugali at performance ng tao para mapabuti ang training, selection at readiness.
2300-research-psychologist.training: Officer Development School sa Newport, RI.

2300-social-worker.title: Social Worker
2300-social-worker.description: Nagbibigay ng counseling, family support at crisis intervention para sa mga Sailors, Marines at kanilang pamilya.
2300-social-worker.training: Officer Development School sa Newport, RI.

2900.title: Navy Nurse (Nurse Corps)
2900.description: Registered nurse na officer na nagbibigay at namumuno sa patient care sa mga ospital, clinic, barko at deployed unit.
2900.training: Officer Development School sa Newport, RI (exempted ang ilang nurse na na-commission sa pamamagitan ng ROTC).

hm.title: Hospital Corpsman
hm.description: Nagbibigay ng medical care sa mga Sailors, Marines at kanilang pamilya, sa mga clinic at ospital, sa barko at sa field.
hm.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 19-linggong Hospital Corps 'A' School sa San Antonio, TX; Field Medical training para sa mga unit ng Marine Corps.

hm-hospital-corpsman-advanced-technical-.title: Hospital Corpsman - Advanced Technical Field (HM-ATF)
hm-hospital-corpsman-advanced-technical-.description: Mga Hospital Corpsman na sinanay bilang special operations, reconnaissance o diving medic na gumagamot ng mga sugatan sa combat at sa mahihirap na lugar.
hm-hospital-corpsman-advanced-technical-.training: Boot camp, Hospital Corps 'A' School (19 na linggo), tapos isa sa tatlong mahabang advanced pipeline tulad ng Special Operations Independent Duty Corpsman course.

hm-mortician.title: Mortician
hm-mortician.description: Specialty ng Hospital Corpsman na kumukuha, naghahanda at nagbabalik nang may dignidad sa mga labi ng mga nasawing service member.
hm-mortician.training: Boot camp, tapos Hospital Corps 'A' School (19 na linggo) sa San Antonio, TX.

4100.title: Navy Chaplain (Chaplain Corps)
4100.description: Clergy officer na namumuno sa mga religious service at nagbibigay ng counseling at spiritual care sa mga service member ng lahat ng pananampalataya.
4100.training: Officer Development School, tapos isang 7-linggong Naval Chaplaincy School course sa Newport, RI.

rp.title: Religious Program Specialist
rp.description: Tumutulong sa mga chaplain sa mga religious program at administration, at nagsisilbing security ng chaplain.
rp.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 8-linggong 'A' School sa Naval Chaplaincy School, Newport, RI.

naval-reactors-engineer.title: Naval Reactors Engineer
naval-reactors-engineer.description: Engineer officer sa headquarters ng Naval Reactors na tumutulong mag-design, mangasiwa at mag-regulate ng mga nuclear propulsion plant ng Navy.
naval-reactors-engineer.training: Officer Development School, tapos specialized nuclear engineering training.

nuclear-power-school-instructor.title: Nuclear Power School Instructor
nuclear-power-school-instructor.description: Officer na nagtuturo ng nuclear engineering at reactor theory sa Nuclear Power School.
nuclear-power-school-instructor.training: Officer Development School, tapos instructor preparation.

nuclear-power-training-unit-instructor.title: Nuclear Power Training Unit Instructor
nuclear-power-training-unit-instructor.description: Officer na nagte-train sa mga Sailors at officer na mag-operate ng mga nuclear reactor prototype.
nuclear-power-training-unit-instructor.training: Officer Development School, Nuclear Power School, tapos prototype training.

nuclear-surface-warfare-officer.title: Nuclear Surface Warfare Officer
nuclear-surface-warfare-officer.description: Surface Warfare Officer na qualified din magpatakbo ng mga nuclear plant ng mga aircraft carrier.
nuclear-surface-warfare-officer.training: OCS, Nuclear Power School at prototype training, kasama ang SWO training.

1120.title: Submarine Officer
1120.description: Namumuno sa mga Sailors sakay ng mga nuclear-powered submarine at nagiging qualified na mag-operate ng mga reactor at armas nito.
1120.training: OCS (o Academy/ROTC), Nuclear Power School, prototype training at ang Submarine Officer Basic Course.

1440.title: Engineering Duty Officer
1440.description: Nagde-design, gumagawa, bumibili at nagme-maintain ng mga barko, submarine at combat system ng Navy.
1440.training: Engineering Duty Officer qualification program at mga acquisition course pagkatapos ng initial officer training.

1800.title: Meteorology & Oceanography Officer (METOC)
1800.description: Nagfo-forecast ng panahon at kondisyon ng karagatan at nagpapayo sa mga commander kung paano naaapektuhan ng kapaligiran ang mga operasyon.
1800.training: Officer Candidate School, tapos Basic Oceanography Accession Training sa Gulfport, MS.

2300-entomologist.title: Entomologist
2300-entomologist.description: Medical Service Corps scientist na kumokontrol sa mga insektong nagdadala ng sakit at mga peste na banta sa mga tauhan.
2300-entomologist.training: Officer Development School sa Newport, RI.

2300-microbiologist.title: Microbiologist
2300-microbiologist.description: Medical Service Corps scientist na nag-aaral ng mga infectious disease at sumusuporta sa mga lab, diagnostics at biodefense.
2300-microbiologist.training: Officer Development School sa Newport, RI.

ag.title: Aerographer's Mate
ag.description: Nagmamasid, nagre-record at nagfo-forecast ng panahon at kondisyon ng karagatan para sa fleet.
ag.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 19-linggong 'A' School sa Keesler AFB, MS.

emn.title: Electrician's Mate (Nuclear)
emn.description: Nag-o-operate at nagme-maintain ng mga electrical system ng nuclear reactor plant sa mga submarine at carrier.
emn.training: Boot camp, mga anim na buwang 'A' School sa Charleston, SC, tapos Nuclear Power School at prototype training.

etn.title: Electronics Technician (Nuclear)
etn.description: Nag-o-operate at nagme-maintain ng reactor control at instrumentation electronics sa mga nuclear propulsion plant.
etn.training: Boot camp, mga anim na buwang 'A' School sa Charleston, SC, tapos Nuclear Power School at prototype training.

mmn.title: Machinist's Mate (Nuclear)
mmn.description: Nag-o-operate at nagme-maintain ng steam, propulsion at reactor-support na mechanical system sa mga nuclear plant.
mmn.training: Boot camp, mga anim na buwang 'A' School sa Charleston, SC, tapos Nuclear Power School at prototype training.

1130.title: Special Warfare Officer (SEAL)
1130.description: Namumuno sa mga Navy SEAL platoon at team sa mga special operations mission.
1130.training: Officer commission, tapos BUD/S, parachute school at SEAL Qualification Training.

1140.title: Explosive Ordnance Disposal Officer
1140.description: Namumuno sa mga Navy EOD team na nag-aalis ng mga pampasabog, mine at IED at sumusuporta sa mga diving at salvage mission.
1140.training: Officer commission, tapos ang EOD at dive training pipeline.

airr.title: Aircrew Rescue Swimmer
airr.description: Isang mabigat na aircrew program kung saan tumatalon ang mga miyembro mula sa helicopter para sagipin ang mga tao sa dagat at nagpapatakbo rin ng mga helicopter mission system; ang mga graduate ay naglilingkod sa isang aircrew rating tulad ng AWS o AWR.
airr.training: Boot camp, prep course, Aircrew Candidate School at Rescue Swimmer School sa Pensacola, FL, tapos aircrew 'A' School; mga dalawang taon lahat-lahat.

eod.title: Explosive Ordnance Disposal Technician
eod.description: Ang bomb squad ng Navy: hinahanap at dini-disarm ang mga pampasabog, mine at IED sa lupa at sa ilalim ng tubig, madalas pa ngang nagda-dive o nagpa-parachute papunta roon.
eod.training: Boot camp, EOD Preparatory Course sa Great Lakes, IL, tapos dive school at EOD school, kasama ang follow-on tactical training.

nd.title: Navy Diver
nd.description: Gumagawa ng underwater salvage, pag-aayos ng barko, search and recovery, at mga submarine rescue mission.
nd.training: Boot camp, isang 7-linggong Diver Preparation Course sa Great Lakes, IL, tapos mga 15-linggong Second Class Dive School sa Panama City, FL.

sb.title: Special Warfare Boat Operator (SWCC)
sb.description: Nag-o-operate ng mabibilis na combat craft para maghatid ng special operations forces at magsagawa ng mga maritime raid at reconnaissance.
sb.training: Boot camp, tapos ang SWCC pipeline (assessment kasama ang Alpha, Bravo at Charlie phase), SERE at jump school.

so.title: Special Warfare Operator (Navy SEAL)
so.description: Elite na special operations commando na nagsasagawa ng mga raid, reconnaissance at counterterrorism mission sa dagat, sa himpapawid at sa lupa.
so.training: Boot camp, tapos mga 56 na linggong initial training kasama ang BUD/S, parachute school at SEAL Qualification Training.

11bx.title: Bomber Pilot
11bx.description: Nagpapalipad ng mga long-range bomber tulad ng B-52, B-1 at B-2 para tamaan ang mga target saanman sa mundo.

11ex.title: Experimental Test Pilot
11ex.description: Bihasang piloto na nagpapalipad ng mga bago at binagong aircraft para i-test ang performance, kaligtasan at mga armas nito bago gamitin sa serbisyo.

11fx.title: Fighter Pilot
11fx.description: Nagpapalipad ng mga fighter at attack jet tulad ng F-35, F-22, F-15, F-16 at A-10 sa air-to-air at air-to-ground na labanan.

11gx.title: Generalist Pilot
11gx.description: Nagpapalipad ng mga aircraft na hindi pasok sa ibang pilot category, tulad ng VIP transport at support aircraft.

11hx.title: Rescue Pilot
11hx.description: Nagpapalipad ng mga rescue helicopter at aircraft tulad ng HH-60W at HC-130J para sagipin ang mga na-isolate o nasugatang tauhan.

11mx.title: Mobility Pilot
11mx.description: Nagpapalipad ng mga cargo at tanker aircraft tulad ng C-17, C-130 at KC-46 para ilipat ang mga tropa at equipment at mag-refuel ng ibang aircraft.

11rx.title: Reconnaissance/Surveillance/Electronic Warfare Pilot
11rx.description: Nagpapalipad ng mga aircraft tulad ng U-2 at RC-135 na nangangalap ng intelligence o nagja-jam ng mga system ng kalaban.

11sx.title: Special Operations Pilot
11sx.description: Nagpapalipad ng mga special operations aircraft tulad ng AC-130J, MC-130J at CV-22, madalas sa gabi at sa mababang altitude.

11ux.title: Remotely Piloted Aircraft Pilot
11ux.description: Nagpapalipad ng mga drone tulad ng MQ-9 Reaper mula sa ground control station para sa mga surveillance at strike mission.

12x.title: Combat Systems Officer
12x.description: Aircrew officer na humahawak ng navigation, paggamit ng armas at electronic warfare sa mga bomber, fighter, gunship at iba pang aircraft.

13bx.title: Air Battle Manager
13bx.description: Dinidirekta ang air battle mula sa mga airborne o ground radar platform, kinokontrol ang mga fighter at mina-manage ang airspace.

13hx.title: Aerospace Physiologist
13hx.description: Namumuno sa mga program na nagpoprotekta sa aircrew mula sa pisikal na stress ng paglipad, tulad ng hypoxia, G-forces at disorientation.

15wx.title: Weather and Environmental Sciences Officer
15wx.description: Namumuno sa mga weather forecasting team at nagpapayo sa mga commander kung paano maaapektuhan ng panahon at kondisyon sa space ang mga operasyon.

1a1x2.title: Mobility Force Aviator
1a1x2.description: Lumilipad bilang enlisted aircrew sa mga airlift at tanker aircraft, pinagsasama ang dating mga role ng loadmaster, flight engineer at boom operator. Depende sa jet, naglo-load sila ng cargo, nagpapatakbo ng mga aircraft system o nagre-refuel ng ibang eroplano habang lumilipad.

1a1x3.title: Special Missions Aviator
